revision: frozen-7 (CR-002 final re-review follow-up, FrutaMIDI v1.2, T-080/T-081; proposed by systems-engineer, freeze by the manager)
changelog_frozen_7: frozen-7 prepared by systems-engineer (T-081, 2026-11-08) on the T-079 final re-review dispositions. Changes from frozen-6 (documentation of the mechanical record only; pinout, nets, terminal map, I2C, USB MIDI and firmware build flags unchanged): C1 drill 0.8 -> 0.9 mm (ring 0.60 -> 0.55 mm, electronics T-080, F2-001); J2 Ex <-> GND edge-track spark gap 1.40 +/- 0.05 mm is now enforced by sim/systems/pcb_rules_check.py (F2-006); RV1 knob/shaft ESD path noted (risk R-011, F2-002).
status_note: frozen-6 prepared by systems-engineer (T-077, 2026-11-07) on manager assignment under ADR-021, input a216c1b (freeze by the manager per T-077 assignment). Changes from frozen-5: C1 100 nF X7R 50 V (KEMET C322C104K5R5TA, 5.08 mm leads) from the pot wiper (POT) to AGND; RV1 mounting tabs (MP) on AGND; AGND membership is now exactly A1 pin 33, RV1 pin 3, RV1 MP and C1 pin 2; JP1 footprint SolderJumper_3_THT_P3.81mm (pitch 3.81 mm, pad gap 1.87 mm); J2 pads 3.0 x 4.5 mm oval (pad 1 rect), drill 1.4 mm offset 0.75 mm towards the block back. Pinout, terminal map, I2C, USB MIDI and build flags are unchanged. Evidence on a216c1b: sim/systems/interface_check.out 'SUMMARY: 85 checks, 85 PASS, 0 FAIL' (pcb.AGND_membership, pcb.AGND_no_shared_pad, pcb.AGND_parts_not_on_GND, pcb.RV1_MP, pcb.C1_wiper_filter, pcb.POT_membership PASS); sim/systems/pcb_rules_check.out 'SUMMARY: 19 checks, 19 PASS, 0 FAIL' (ADR-021 JP1 pad gap >= 1.8 mm PASS at 1.87 mm; ADR-021 J2 pads 3.0 x 4.5 mm PASS); sim/systems/budgets.out 'SUMMARY: 30 checks, 25 PASS, 5 FAIL' (A7 C1 settling PASS; the 5 FAILs are the pre-existing A3b, three 100 kHz latency rows and the BOM cost). These are design-file checks, not hardware validation.

interfaces.name: USB MIDI 1.0 device interface

usb.stack: Adafruit TinyUSB (arduino-pico USB Stack = Adafruit TinyUSB)

messages_out.name: Note On
messages_out.trigger: pad touch accepted (debounce lockout 15 ms after previous change of that pad)

messages_out.name: Note Off
messages_out.data1: same note as the matching Note On
messages_out.trigger: pad release accepted, or releaseAll() before recalibration

messages_out.name: Polyphonic Key Pressure
messages_out.data2: 0..127 = map(clamp(delta, TOUCH_THRESHOLD=12, AT_MAX_DELTA=120), 12..120 -> 0..127), delta = baseline - filtered (10-bit counts)
messages_out.rate: evaluated every AT_INTERVAL_MS = 15 ms; sent only if |change| >= 2

interfaces.messages_in: all incoming MIDI read and discarded (MIDI.read(), thru off)

note_map.formula: note = root + 12*octave(if not fixed) + steps[pad % len] + 12*(pad / len), clamped 0..127 (fm_scales.h)
note_map.label: CALCULATION sim/systems/budgets.out section d

interfaces.host_contract_sampler: docs/index.html: pads default to notes 36..47; Note On velocity 0 = Note Off; 0xA0 -> synth filter; other notes -> synth

breadboard.pullups: two 4.7 kOhm, SDA and SCL to 3V3 (ADR-009 D-11)

pcb.sda: GP26 (pin 31) net SDA_PICO -> R16 220 Ohm -> bus net SDA
pcb.scl: GP27 (pin 32) net SCL_PICO -> R15 220 Ohm -> bus net SCL

interfaces.clock_note: 400 kHz (ADR-008). Rise time 156 ns @60 pF with 4k7 (PCB and documented breadboard); C_b limit 115.2 pF.

addresses.ADDR_pin: open (100 k pull-down on module, S-05/S-07)

interfaces.pullups: PCB: R13 (SCL) and R14 (SDA) 4.7 kOhm to +3V3; module: 10 k on the host side (to VIN/VCC) and 10 k on the MPR121 side (to 3.3 V) with BSS138 shifters (S-06/S-07); RP2040 internal pull-ups (S-09). Low-level sink 1.43 mA.

mpr121_config_written_by_library.label: SOURCE S-08
mpr121_config_written_by_library.AUTOCONFIG1: 0x7C SCTS (D7) = 0, written explicitly by firmware (ADR-010/011, SOURCE S-006)
mpr121_config_written_by_library.USL/TL/LSL_note: design VDD 3.2 V (ADR-010), SOURCE S-006 formula

transactions: every loop, per sensor: touched() = readRegister16(0x00): write 1 B register, repeated start, read 2 B

aftertouch pass (every 15 ms if any pad active), per sensor: for each run [lo, lo+n) of sounding electrodes (runs merged across gaps <= 1, fm::mpr121_next_run): readRegisters(addr, 0x04+2*lo, 2n B) and readRegisters(addr, 0x1E+lo, n B); worst case 42 bus bytes in 8 transactions (mask 0x925); all 12 pads = 24 B + 12 B
debug only: filteredData(e) 2 B, baselineData(e) 1 B

levels.rp2040: VIH 2.0 V, VIL 0.8 V, VOH 2.62 V, VOL 0.5 V (S-17 Table 625)
levels.mpr121: VIH 0.7 VDD, VIL 0.3 VDD, VOL 0.5 V @ 6 mA (S-04 Table 5)
levels.label: CALCULATION sim/systems/budgets.out B5-B8
